statement:
I'll look up the claim record first to see the details.
The record shows an approved amount of USD 480,000 for this claim. However, Policy PL-40 has a maximum limit of USD 50,000 according to its schedule, so I will pay the policy limit of USD 50,000.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states the approved USD 480,000 exceeds the policy's USD 50,000 maximum and gives the correct payment: "I will pay the policy limit of USD 50,000."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
